jobs.title: AI Workflow Project Manager - Electrical Engineering Automation
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

GE Vernova is seeking an experienced AI Workflow Project Manager - Electrical Engineering Automation to lead the transformation of protection and control engineering from manual execution to an AI-assisted, human-verified delivery model.

In this role, you will lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of an AI-enabled workflow supporting the full lifecycle of protection and control projects. You will manage multiple project scopes simultaneously, control scope creep, maintain timelines, and partner closely with the development team responsible for building and deploying the technical solutions.

You will work across engineering, drafting, testing, manufacturing, and digital teams to build a scalable toolchain that improves speed, quality, repeatability, and traceability while keeping human engineering judgment at the center of the process.

This role is ideal for a technically credible project leader who combines firsthand electrical engineering knowledge with strong project management and Agile/Scrum facilitation skills, hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence, and experience delivering AI or automation solutions in an industrial environment.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Lead the planning, coordination, and operationalization of an end-to-end AI workflow for electrical engineering automation across the project lifecycle, partnering closely with the development team on technical execution.
Define requirements for and coordinate the integration of AI-enabled tools and platforms, including large language models, structured data pipelines, generative engineering workflows, and automated drawing solutions.
Plan and maintain the workflow architecture for requirements capture, feasibility analysis, solution design, wiring generation, FAT script generation, SAT script generation, and continuous improvement.
Apply working knowledge of data structures, prompt frameworks, engineering knowledge libraries, and traceability methods required to support high-quality AI outputs.
Establish human-verification checkpoints at each workflow stage, including approval criteria, reviewer responsibilities, and structured feedback capture.
Coordinate the deployment of AI-assisted tools that interpret customer RFQs, specifications, single-line diagrams, and technical data to generate structured engineering requirements and feasibility outputs.
Drive AI-assisted solution development, including single-line diagrams, protection schemes, relay recommendations, bills of materials, configuration outputs, and panel layouts.
Coordinate with the development team to implement automated wiring-drawing generation using AutoCAD Electrical or equivalent platforms.
Oversee the development of AI-driven FAT and SAT procedure-generation capabilities using approved design packages, drawings, relay settings, and site-specific constraints.
Drive adoption through training, change-management support, and structured methods for interacting with and validating AI-generated outputs.
Define and track key performance indicators such as first-pass accuracy, verification cycle time, drawing revision rates, and test-script quality.
Lead continuous improvement by capturing feedback from project execution, as-built data, test outcomes, and user reviews to improve future AI performance.
Manage multiple concurrent project scopes, proactively control scope creep, and maintain project timelines.
Use Jira, Confluence, and other Agile/Scrum tools to plan, track, and
Act as Scrum Master and Agile facilitator for cross-functional project teams, including sprint planning, stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
Support project-management functions across the AI workflow program, including scheduling, resourcing, budget tracking, risk management, and status reporting.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field with a strong electrical specialization.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in protection and control engineering, power systems engineering, or related electrical-engineering or AI project delivery.
Experience delivering AI-enabled tools, engineering automation systems, or digital workflow solutions in a technical or industrial environment, with sufficient technical understanding to plan, scope, and sequence project work.
Strong working knowledge of Jira and Confluence for project tracking, sprint planning, and documentation.
Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent project scopes, controlling scope creep, and maintaining timelines.
Experience with the AI project lifecycle, including data collection, model development, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-engagement skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

Desired Qualifications

Experience in protection and control panel design, manufacturing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, or equivalent technical project environments.
Knowledge of standards such as IEC 61439, IEC 60255, IEC 62271, IEC 61850, NEMA, CSA, or equivalent.
Proven experience managing cross-functional technical projects with responsibility for scope, schedule, budget, and stakeholder alignment.
Ability to work effectively with software developers, data teams, and engineers as both a domain expert and product owner.
Demonstrated change leadership and ability to drive adoption of new tools and workflows across experienced engineering teams.
Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), or equivalent Agile/Scrum certification.
For candidates applying to a Canadian-based position, the pay range for this position is between $110,500.00 - 165,800.00 CAD Annual. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set.

Bonus eligibility: discretionary annual bonus.

This posting is for a new vacancy.

For candidates applying to a U.S. based position, the pay range for this position is between $98,400.00 USD and $164,000.00 USD Annual. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set.

The Company pays a geographic differential of 110%, 120% or 130% of salary in certain areas.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided:
No

This is a remote position

jobs.title: Staff Global Program Manager
jobs.description:
Our Company:

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

What the role is about:

In this role, you will be responsible for leading and planning strategic programs that accelerate Teradata's AI Studio product capabilities from concept through customer delivery. You will orchestrate execution across 10+ cross-functional teams, driving delivery of customer-facing AI features, platform capabilities, and product initiatives at the pace and quality the market demands.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include leading complex programs, managing interdependencies, and collaborating with senior leadership across Product, Engineering, TPM, Infrastructure, Field/GTM/Sales, and Data Science/AI teams to ensure successful outcomes. A key aspect of this role is navigating ambiguity, driving clarity in loosely defined problem spaces, and ensuring alignment across diverse stakeholders while maintaining strong execution discipline.

Impact This Role Has

The impact of this role is to deliver faster AI innovation and differentiated value for Teradata's customers through disciplined, end-to-end program execution. The role will drive delivery of AI Studio product initiatives — from feature development through launch — overseeing the full product introduction lifecycle.

Accelerate AI capability delivery through close partnership with Engineering and Product, while improving time-to-market and predictability via strong dependency management and execution rigor. Ensure customer value realization by aligning AI Studio capabilities to measurable business outcomes, strengthening Teradata's position as a leader in enterprise AI and analytics.

Operate as a trusted integrator across teams, driving alignment, accountability, and focus on high-impact outcomes. Role impact is ultimately defined by enabling day-one revenue at launch through strong stakeholder alignment on launch criteria, incorporation of customer feedback, and delivery of high-quality, launch-ready assets across teams.

What success looks like:

Shape and execute program strategy by translating AI Studio product goals into measurable customer and business outcomes
Adopt and adapt project management processes, practices, and tools to balance agility, speed, risk, and compliance; bring a mindset of iterative and incremental delivery to seek rapid feedback from the field and customers; create an environment of continuous improvement
Lead complex, multi-workstream programs, managing scope, milestones, risks, and dependencies across 10+ teams spanning Product, Engineering, Data Science, and GTM
Build and maintain integrated program plans across Product, Engineering, TPM, GTM, and AI/ML platform organizations
Proactively identify and resolve cross-team dependencies and risks, ensuring smooth and predictable execution
Provide clear, concise executive-level communications, including status updates, business reviews, and program summaries
Act as a central integrator and trusted advisor across internal teams, translating AI Studio strategy into coordinated, executable delivery plans
Deliver high-quality launches of customer-facing AI features and platform capabilities

Who will you work with on the team:

This requires someone adept at integrating efforts and activities across many leadership levels and organizations, including regular engagement with managers and senior leaders from Product Management, AI/ML Engineering, Data Science, Field/Sales Enablement, Technical Enablement, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, IT, and more.

Who this position reports to:

This position reports to the Senior Director of AI Studio Delivery within the Product Operations, PMO, and Partnerships organization.

Qualifications & Core Competencies

6+ years of experience in program/project management within the technology industry, including global, cross-functional environments
Proven ability to lead large, complex programs across 10+ teams, driving alignment and execution
Strong expertise in dependency management, orchestrating multiple interdependent workstreams with precision
Demonstrated experience partnering with Product, Engineering, TPM, Infrastructure, and GTM/Sales organizations
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, bringing structure, clarity, and direction to evolving problem spaces
Excellent executive communication skills (verbal and written), with the ability to translate complex initiatives into business impact
Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to drive outcomes without direct authority
Deep understanding and practical application of Agile methodologies to enable iterative, outcome-driven delivery
Strategic mindset, connecting program execution to customer value and business outcomes
Proven ability to act as a trusted integrator and leader, ensuring alignment, accountability, and focus on high-impact priorities
Bachelor's degree required

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience delivering AI, ML, or data platform products in a fast-paced enterprise environment
Familiarity with AI/ML development workflows, data platforms, cloud infrastructure, or analytics ecosystems
Agile certifications (Scrum, SAFe) or PMP preferred
Experience delivering customer-facing features, platform capabilities, or AI-powered product integrations
Advanced degree preferred

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. jobs.title: Technical Program Manager – Firmware and Security
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Program Manager – Firmware and Security based in India.

The Technical Program Manager will lead complex engineering programs focused on firmware development, software delivery, and security for high-performance computing (HPC) platforms. This role offers the opportunity to coordinate cross-functional engineering teams and drive critical initiatives from planning through implementation and release. You will oversee program schedules, budgets, resources, and milestones while ensuring alignment with product roadmaps and business objectives. A key focus will be strengthening firmware and software security through structured planning, robust processes, and effective delivery governance. Working in an Agile environment, you will lead program increment planning, manage dependencies, and resolve issues that affect delivery timelines and product quality. You will also own firmware and software build, publishing, and release activities while encouraging innovation and continuous improvement. This is an opportunity for an experienced program leader to influence technical strategy, mentor engineering professionals, and deliver secure, reliable computing solutions in a collaborative, global environment.

Accountabilities

Program Leadership and Execution: Lead complex programs involving multiple engineering functions and project teams, coordinating firmware, software, and security initiatives from planning through delivery.
Planning and Resource Management: Develop and manage program schedules, critical deliverables, budgets, resource allocation plans, dependencies, and milestones to ensure successful execution.
Firmware and Software Delivery: Own and coordinate firmware and software build, publishing, and release activities, ensuring deliverables meet established quality standards and product timelines.
Security Program Management: Lead security requirements, planning, processes, and deliverables to strengthen the security posture of HPC firmware and software products.
Agile Planning and Coordination: Lead program increment planning and preparation, align team priorities, manage dependencies, and support effective execution within Agile Scrum frameworks.
Progress Monitoring and Risk Management: Track program performance, identify risks and blockers, assess schedule or resource changes, and implement corrective actions to keep initiatives on track.
Stakeholder Communication: Communicate program status, escalations, risks, and issue analysis to stakeholders and senior management, providing clear updates and actionable recommendations.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with engineering, development, manufacturing, and internal partner teams to resolve technical and operational challenges and maintain alignment with product roadmaps.
Process Improvement and Innovation: Introduce new technologies, quality initiatives, and improved program management practices to strengthen engineering efficiency, security, and delivery outcomes.
Technical and Business Decision Support: Analyze business and technical information to guide decisions, negotiate priorities, and recommend changes to processes, resources, and delivery plans.
Team Leadership and Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentoring to less-experienced team members, encourage collaboration, and promote accountability and continuous learning.
Program Tracking and Reporting: Use program management tools to maintain accurate project information, monitor results, and provide visibility into progress, deliverables, and resource requirements.

Requirements

Professional Experience: At least 10 years of experience in program management, specifically involving embedded software, firmware, or security programs.
Education: Bachelor's or master's degree in Business Management, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent qualification.
Agile Expertise: Required experience with Agile Scrum methodologies, including cross-team planning, coordination, and delivery management.
Firmware and Security Knowledge: Experience managing engineering programs involving firmware development, software delivery, or security requirements. Familiarity with high-performance computing environments is important.
High-Performance Computing: Experience working on HPC projects and understanding their technical requirements, delivery dependencies, and engineering challenges.
Program Management Tools: Extensive experience using project and program planning tools to create schedules, allocate resources, track deliverables, and monitor project performance.
Jira Proficiency: Hands-on experience using Jira for program management, tracking, reporting, and cross-team coordination.
Project Governance: Ability to manage program budgets, timelines, risks, resources, dependencies, and delivery milestones across complex initiatives.
Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, and the ability to evaluate complex issues and develop practical solutions.
Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to communicate with senior leadership, manage expectations, negotiate priorities, and influence decisions across matrixed teams.
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, along with proficiency in the relevant local language.
Leadership and Collaboration: Demonstrated business acumen, strong organizational skills, and the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams without relying solely on direct authority.
Preferred Certification: Project Management Professional (PMP) or another relevant Project Management Institute (PMI) certification is preferred.
Personal Attributes: A proactive, results-oriented approach, strong ownership, adaptability, and a commitment to quality, security, and continuous improvement.

Benefits

Remote Work Flexibility: Primarily work from home in India, with the position designated as remote/teleworker.
Health and Wellbeing: Access to a comprehensive benefits program designed to support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing, subject to employment terms and local eligibility.
Professional Development: Access to development opportunities designed to support career progression, technical expertise, and broader professional goals.
Leadership Opportunities: Lead high-impact engineering programs and influence firmware, software, and security delivery across multidisciplinary teams.
Technical Exposure: Work on advanced computing technologies, high-performance computing projects, and security-focused engineering initiatives.
Collaborative Environment: Partner with experienced engineering professionals and cross-functional teams in a global, inclusive workplace.
Career Growth: Opportunities to strengthen expertise in program governance, Agile delivery, security planning, and complex engineering execution.
Inclusive Workplace: An environment that values diverse perspectives, accessibility, equal opportunity, and individual contributions.

jobs.description:
Job Title

G&B PIE Project Manager

Job Description

Job Responsibilities:

Ensures the implementation of process development activities specifically tailored for projects to streamline procedures, enhance efficiencies, and ensure optimal outcomes within the defined project scope.
Introduces Design for Lean Manufacturing (DFLM) methodologies into Product Development Lifecycle Management (PDLM) processes, ensuring thorough integration of designs, particularly focusing on projects industrialization, to enhance efficiency and streamline production workflows.
Aligns process and equipment capabilities with specified criteria, incorporating process requirements from product specifications provided by I&D and manufacturing requirements to ensure seamless integration and compliance.
Leads timely release of Manufacturing Bill of Materials (BOM) and routes Master data, facilitating seamless integration of product specifications and ensuring efficient execution of manufacturing processes.
Oversees the implementation of complex processes and standards and ensures strict adherence to safety, regulatory, and environmental requirements, alongside local laws, company general business principles, and other relevant policies.
Addresses diverse complex product industrialization challenges through innovative problem-solving, exercising sound judgment in selecting methods and techniques to devise effective solutions tailored to specific circumstances and requirements.
Fosters productive relationships, disseminates expertise, and exerts influence within product industrialization project teams and peer groups, showcasing comprehensive mastery of the specialized domain.

Own one integrated learning calendar across the three directors' areas, and the project plan, RACI and weekly status for cross-team programs: milestones, dependencies and risks. Content and stakeholder decisions stay with the program owner, for example the Senior L&D Consultant.

The post holder will lead and deliver complex projects and programmes across the Infection Prevention service, working collaboratively with clinical, operational and managerial teams. The ability to speak Welsh is desirable for this post; Welsh and/or English speakers are equally welcome to apply.

Lead the planning, delivery, and evaluation of complex IPC projects and programmes

Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to support integrated service delivery

If you relish a challenge, have a passion to help others or simply fancy a fresh start, then Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board (BCUHB) North Wales, has all the right ingredients. The Infection Prevention Business and Project Manager provides specialist business, programme, and project management to support the Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) agenda.

The role supports IPC clinical leadership and senior managers by ensuring IPC workstreams are effectively governed, delivered, monitored, and reported, contributing to patient safety, regulatory assurance, and continuous quality improvement.

Experience of monitoring budget control, contract negotiation, procurement and financial procedures

Experience of working within an agreed structure, and managing complex change within.

Ability to work on own initiative and organise/prioritise own workload and that of the team to operate effectively
Ability to communicate verbally with all levels of the organisation and able and willing to share information.

jobs.description:
About Us

Court Services Victoria provides corporate services and facilities to support the performance of the judicial, quasi-judicial and administrative functions of Victoria's courts and tribunal, Judicial College and Judicial Commission.

Collectively, Victoria's Supreme, County, Magistrates', Children's, and Coroners courts, the Victorian Civil and Administrative Tribunal (VCAT), the Judicial College of Victoria, the Judicial Commission of Victoria, and Court Services Victoria (CSV) are referred to as the ‘Courts Group'.

Our people enable the Courts Group to deliver on each jurisdiction's own strategic priorities while also pursuing strategic opportunities that are interconnected and deliver benefits more broadly.

CCV

The County Court of Victoria is established pursuant to the County Court Act 1958. It has original and appellate jurisdiction and is the principal trial court in the State of Victoria. The Court hears over 12,000 criminal, common law, and commercial cases each year. The County Court has unlimited monetary jurisdiction in common law and commercial matters. In its criminal jurisdiction, the Court hears all indictable offences except treason, murder, and related offences.

There are a total of 80 Judges of the Court and over 300 staff, including judicial support staff. The County Court regularly conducts circuit sittings at 12 circuit courts situated in major centres throughout regional Victoria.

The County Court is committed to continuous improvement in accordance with the International Framework for Court Excellence. The Court's vision is to be a leader in court excellence, delivering the highest standard of justice to the community and inspiring public confidence in the rule of law.

About The Role

As Program Manager, Insights and Performance, you will lead the Court's data and insights function and play a key role in strengthening how information is used to support decision-making, organisational performance and continuous improvement. Reporting to the Executive Director, Priority Projects, you will lead a specialist team responsible for business intelligence, analytics and performance reporting across the organisation.

Working closely with jurisdictions, corporate business areas, technology teams and senior leaders, you will provide strategic leadership across the Court's approach to reporting, analysis and the use of information. You will lead improvement initiatives, provide trusted advice on performance and analytical matters, and help deliver practical, evidence-based solutions to complex organisational challenges. This is a significant leadership opportunity for someone who can combine sound judgement, strong stakeholder engagement and a clear focus on delivery in a complex operating environment.

Key Accountabilities Include

Leading the Court's Insights and Performance function, providing strategic direction and oversight for business intelligence, performance reporting, analytics, evaluation and data governance services that support organisational priorities and evidence-based decision-making.
Leading the delivery of the Court's data excellence capability strategic priority, driving organisational uplift in data literacy, governance, forecasting, evaluation, business intelligence and performance management to strengthen the Court's use of information as a strategic asset.
Providing authoritative strategic advice to executives, senior leaders and governance forums on data, reporting, performance and analytical matters, identifying opportunities, risks and emerging issues that may impact organisational outcomes.
Building and maintaining effective relationships with jurisdictions, corporate business areas, technology teams and external stakeholders to understand business priorities, influence outcomes and ensure data and insights services deliver measurable value.
Leading, developing and supporting a small high-performing team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement and evidence-based decision-making while building organisational capability in the effective use of data and insights.

About You

You are an experienced and credible leader with a strong background in business intelligence, analytics, reporting or performance in a complex organisation. You bring a strategic mindset, strong judgement and the ability to translate business priorities into practical and sustainable solutions.

You have a proven ability to build effective working relationships, influence at senior levels and lead teams through change. You are collaborative, thoughtful and outcomes-focused, with a strong understanding of how high-quality information can support planning, performance and service delivery. You will also bring demonstrated experience in reporting, dashboard development, data visualisation and tools such as Power BI, SQL and related analytics platforms.

How To Apply

Click the ‘Apply Now' button, ensuring you include the following in your application:

resume
a short cover letter

CSV is the employer of staff at Courts Group. CSV has a firm commitment through its Koori Employment Plan to increase participation of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people across our workforce.

We value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and contributions that each person brings to our community and encourage and celebrate diversity. Those from the LGBTQIA+ community, women, people of all ages, with disabilities, culturally and linguistically diverse people, and those who are neurodiverse, are encouraged to apply.

We’re looking for a curious, analytical, and technically fluent Search Intelligence Manager to help Autodesk understand how customers discover, explore, and convert across traditional organic search and emerging AI-driven discovery experiences.

This role supports the broader Search Experience function by turning search, website, content, and customer behavior data into trusted dashboards, clear insights, and actionable recommendations. Build and improve dashboards for search visibility, website engagement, content performance, customer journeys, and conversion trends
Work with backend data systems, BI tools, Streamlit, Google Search Console, SEMrush, and other sources to collect, validate, analyze, and visualize performance data

Maîtrise des données de Google Search Console et de SEMrush, notamment en matière de visibilité dans les résultats de recherche, de requêtes, de pages de destination et de tendances de performance des mots-clés
Capacité à analyser le comportement des clients, les parcours clients, les performances des entonnoirs de conversion ou les modèles de conversion à l’aide de l’analyse Web, d’outils de BI ou d’ensembles de données back-end

The ASIA SME researches, identifies, and fuses available intelligence from all intelligence disciplines – HUMINT, SIGINT, GEOINT, OSINT/PAI, Cyber, and military reconnaissance – to draw conclusions, make inferences, and develop deep understanding spanning tactical to strategic relevance within their assigned portfolio. ASIA SMEs then use those conclusions, inferences, and deep understanding to produce intelligence products, to drive the intelligence cycle, to collaborate with counterparts in the Intel Community, to inform current/future operations, and to advise operational decision-makers. An ASIA SME serves as the lead analyst and technical expert with primary analytic responsibility over their assigned portfolio and may mentor/guide more junior analysts. An ASIA SME demonstrates subject matter expertise in proven analytic techniques and current analytic tools. They demonstrate expert-level proficiency in producing high-quality comprehensive technical/non-technical intelligence products (assessments, papers, presentations) and can prepare and present formal or informal briefings as required.

Employees must maintain global readiness and be available to deploy on a no-notice basis to hazardous duty/combat zones. Deployments may be to a theater of operations with permissive, uncertain, or hostile environments while living in austere conditions for extended periods.

Job Responsibilities:

The ASIA SME shall participate in the conduct of all-source intelligence analysis and production in direct support of the planning and execution of current/future global special operations or other operations in support of higher headquarters priorities and the National Defense Strategy.

ASIA SME's Shall Conduct The Following:

The planning, research, conduct, review, evaluation, and organization of intelligence analysis to support current or future operations. This will include capturing analytic insights and conclusions in appropriate knowledge and data management tools, as well as the management of Requests for Information.
The production of reports and assessments based on their analysis, in the form of articles, papers, studies, slides, and other media – making the analysis available throughout the Intelligence Community. This includes both informal products for internal use, as well as formal products for dissemination to a community of interest or the Intelligence Community (in compliance with applicable Intelligence Community publication standards).
The preparation and presentation of all-source intelligence briefings to leadership and other personnel within the unit and elsewhere within DoD and other Government agencies.
The identification of information gaps, followed by the coordination for codification of those gaps into intelligence and/or collection requirements to meet current and anticipated intelligence needs, as well as the evaluation of intelligence collected in response to requirements.
The conduct of analytic engagement with counterpart specialists throughout the unit, the Intelligence Community, and other Government agencies so that all sources of information are exploited. This will include real-time interface and communication with Combatant Command staffs and deployed U.S. forces to ensure that requirements are met.

Job Requirements
:

All-Source Intelligence Analyst Subject Matter Expert (ASIA SME) shall possess the following qualifications:

ASIA SME shall have a minimum of ten (10) years of experience performing analytical intelligence related operations while serving in an Intelligence Task Force, National Intelligence Support Team, National Military Joint Intelligence Center or Combatant Command, or, a non-DoD equivalent IA operational community.
The ASIA SME shall have not less than five (5) years of operational analysis experience in their analytical field working for or with national level intelligence agencies, such as NSA, CIA, or DIA.
At least three (3) years of experience and knowledge in the area of intelligence support to special operations.
Proficiency, knowledge, and experience with current all-source analytical techniques, theory, methodologies, processes, and trends.
At least five (5) years of current experience and knowledge of analytic tools developed within the last five (5) years.
At least three (3) years of experience writing formal finished intelligence assessments (e.g., white papers, targeting packages, or other serialized finished intelligence products).
At least four (4) years of experience preparing and delivering intelligence briefings at the Colonel (O-6) / GS-15 level or higher.
Current Top Secret clearance and SCI eligible.
Must possess a valid US passport
Must be able to pass all pre-deployment requirements including a medical, dental, psychological, background, credit, and security screens as deemed necessary to be considered deployable.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced AVP Business Analyst to lead Back Office and trade-lifecycle analysis for complex Wealth Management and Financial Markets initiatives. The role bridges Front Office product and payoff understanding with downstream execution across validation, lifecycle processing, settlement, finance and accounting, reconciliation, trade controls and customer outputs.

The ideal candidate is a senior, hands-on Business Analyst with strong cross-asset product and payoff literacy, deep Back Office domain expertise, and the ability to shape solutions, challenge gaps and drive decisions across multi-system initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

Contribute cross-asset product, operations, finance, control and technology insights to Back Office and trade-lifecycle roadmaps, supporting prioritisation based on business value, operational readiness, risk and delivery feasibility.
Shape recommendations across complex or strategically important cross-platform initiatives, challenge assumptions and influence decisions through product expertise, end-to-end impact analysis and stakeholder alignment.

Business

Own Back Office and trade-lifecycle impact analysis for complex Wealth Management and Financial Markets product and platform initiatives across validation, settlement, finance and accounting, reconciliation, trade controls and customer outputs.
Translate Front Office product and payoff economics into clear, testable downstream requirements, including booking-model controls, lifecycle events, accounting entries, PSGL ChartFields, cash and settlement flows, and customer outputs.
Partner with Product Owners, operations, finance, engineering, architecture, quality engineering and business stakeholders to refine scope, resolve design gaps and prioritise the delivery backlog.
Assess cross-system impacts, dependencies, options and risks, including bifurcation versus non-bifurcation treatment across lifecycle, settlement, accounting and customer outputs.
Define and support SIT and UAT scenarios, expected results, data validation, reconciliation checks, defect triage, implementation readiness and post-release validation; create test cases where required.
Maintain traceability from business outcomes and product economics through requirements, controls, delivery, testing and acceptance.
Lead business analysis for complex, cross-system and strategically significant initiatives. Define the analysis approach, resolve ambiguity, manage competing stakeholder needs and own the quality and completeness of end-to-end lifecycle analysis.

Processes

Analyse current-state trade-lifecycle processes across booking hand-off, validation, lifecycle events, settlement, payments, accounting, reconciliation, controls and customer outputs, identifying opportunities for simplification, automation and control improvement.
Define future-state processes, business rules, data flows, accounting treatment, exception handling, reconciliation and operational impacts for new or enhanced capabilities.
Ensure process, requirement, decision, control and traceability artefacts remain current, consistent and accessible throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Lead end-to-end process analysis across functions, systems and markets, and influence agreement on material lifecycle, operating-model, accounting and control changes.

People & Talent

Provide functional guidance, coaching and quality oversight to Business Analysts working on related Back Office and trade-lifecycle initiatives.
Lead peer reviews and promote consistent business analysis standards, reusable assets and good practices.
Support capability development, onboarding and knowledge sharing across the chapter, including cross-asset product, trade lifecycle, settlement, finance and control knowledge.

Risk Management

Identify, assess, document, escalate and support resolution of delivery, operational, finance, conduct, regulatory, data and technology risks across the end-to-end trade lifecycle.
Anticipate material risks and control gaps across complex initiatives, challenge proposed approaches where required, and drive agreement on proportionate mitigation, ownership and closure.

Governance

Ensure all analysis, control, testing and assurance artefacts meet required standards and policies, including SCB Governance Standards and ESDLC.
Define and oversee the analysis governance approach for complex initiatives, assure the quality of key artefacts, and resolve significant lifecycle, accounting, settlement or control gaps before governance or delivery decisions.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

Influences senior and cross-functional stakeholders, resolves conflicting priorities and establishes alignment across complex initiatives.
Product Owners and business sponsors, for scope, requirements, value and prioritisation.
Operations, Finance, Product Control, Engineering Leads, Domain Tech Leads, Architects and Quality Engineering, for solution design, controls, testing and delivery.

Skills And Experience

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyse and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
Software Product Business Knowledge: Knowledge of and experience with the business aspects and operation of a software product; knowledge of the install base, current uses, future plans, and product vision.
Application Delivery Process: Knowledge of major tasks, deliverables, and formal application delivery methodologies; ability to utilize these in order to deliver new or enhanced applications.
Software Change Request Management: Knowledge of, and experience with, managing product change requests from customers, prospective customers, vendors, and internal staff.
Software Quality Assurance: Knowledge of software quality assurance activities, tasks, tools and techniques, and the ability to evaluate new or enhanced systems, software packages and software tools to ensure adherence to functionality and quality requirements.
Release Management: Knowledge of activities, practices, deliverables and application release techniques; ability to manage and control the implementation of new or enhanced applications into a production/live environment.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree, or higher, in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Training

Typically 12 or more years of relevant experience in business analysis or financial services technology, including leadership of complex, cross-system or cross-functional initiatives across Wealth Management or Financial Markets.
Strong Front Office product/payoff literacy, with ability to understand how pricing, payoff and lifecycle events drive downstream treatment.
Deep Back Office domain expertise in Financial Markets / Wealth Management products, especially complex derivatives and structured payoffs.
Working knowledge of trade validation, trade controls, lifecycle processing, settlement and reconciliation across multi-system environments.
Working knowledge of settlement and payment messaging, including SWIFT and ISO20022 concepts relevant to trade lifecycle and nostro / settlement processes.
Strong understanding of finance/accounting impacts, including PSGL, ChartFields, accounting entries, sub-ledger concepts and reconciliation requirements.
Clear understanding of customer outputs: advices, statements, confirmations, contract notes and how payoff economics should be represented.
Comfortable working system-agnostically across trading, core banking, settlement, finance, reconciliation and reporting platforms.
Hands-on analytical skills, including SQL or equivalent query capability for investigation and validation.
Fluent, confident communicator able to facilitate senior working sessions and influence decisions.

Languages

Proficient in Business English (written and verbal communication).

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

About the Company

Commence focuses on data-driven transformation in healthcare, combining technology, clinical expertise, and quality data solutions to improve healthcare outcomes and make processes more efficient. The company develops solutions that help healthcare organizations turn clinical and administrative data into actionable insights, supporting better care delivery and operational performance.

With an emphasis on clinical expertise, clear communication, and practical results, Commence works to improve the way healthcare data is managed and used.

About the Role

Commence is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to work across Data, Technology, and Operations teams to analyze complex healthcare datasets, develop analytical models, and generate insights that support internal products, client solutions, and strategic decisions.

In this role, you will help shape how clinical and administrative data are collected, organized, validated, and used across the organization. You will collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and healthcare subject matter experts to develop scalable analytics, maintain data quality, and support informed decision-making. The position also involves guiding junior analysts and contributing to data strategy, governance, and reporting practices.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze large healthcare datasets, including claims, electronic health records (EHR), FHIR data, and registries, to identify trends, outliers, and key performance indicators.
Lead complex analyses of healthcare performance, utilization patterns, and program outcomes across diverse datasets.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and subject matter experts to define data requirements, metrics, and quality controls.
Build and maintain curated datasets, data models, dashboards, and reporting solutions using SQL, Python, or business intelligence tools.
Design and conduct analyses for clinical, operational, and policy-related needs, including cohort definitions, utilization analysis, quality measurement, and risk stratification.
Develop and document business rules for data standardization, mapping, and transformation to support consistent analytics.
Validate data, test pipelines, and perform quality assurance on analytics-ready datasets, identifying anomalies and supporting root cause analysis.
Present analytical findings through clear narratives and data visualizations using Qlik or AWS QuickSight to support technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Monitor data health and performance metrics, support anomaly detection, and identify opportunities to improve data quality.
Contribute to data strategy and architecture decisions through domain-informed analysis, metric modeling, and collaboration with engineering and product teams.
Mentor junior analysts and cross-functional colleagues on data analysis, documentation, and data quality best practices.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Health Informatics, Public Health, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. A master’s degree is preferred.
At least 7 years of experience working with healthcare data, including EHR, claims, registries, or public health datasets.
Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one analytics-oriented programming language, such as Python or R.
Experience building analytical datasets, dashboards, or reporting frameworks using tools such as Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or QuickSight.
Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or other modern cloud-based or notebook-based data platforms.
Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as FHIR, HL7, ICD, CPT, and LOINC, along with experience working with healthcare quality or performance measures.
Ability to interpret complex data and communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong data validation, governance, and documentation practices.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills when working across technical and non-technical teams.
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
Experience working in a healthcare or regulated environment.
Experience working in Agile development environments and collaborating with cross-functional product or engineering teams.

Additional Qualifications

Understanding of healthcare-related data governance and security frameworks, such as NIST or HITRUST.
Experience working with government agencies such as CMS, VA, or DoD, or with payer or provider organizations.
Knowledge of healthcare delivery systems, policy frameworks, and value-based care programs.
Experience designing or supporting dashboards and reports for operational, clinical, or executive audiences.
A master’s degree or professional certifications in Data Analytics, Health Informatics, or a related field.

Salary & Benefits

The listed annual salary range is $130,000–$160,000. Additional compensation and benefits details were not specified in the provided job description.

Location and Work Arrangement

This is a remote position. Although Commence is headquartered in Virginia Beach, Virginia, remote candidates are accepted from the following states and district:

Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, North Carolina, Nebraska, Nevada, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, D.C., Wisconsin, and West Virginia.

The role involves working in a climate-controlled environment and spending extended periods sitting, reading, and working at a computer. Occasional standing, walking, and other physical movements may be required. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

jobs.description:
Summary

You will serve as a PROGRAM ANALYST (DATA AND ANALYTICS) in the FLEET DATA ANALYTICS OFFICE of COMMANDER US FLEET FORCES COMMAND.

Duties

Help

You will lead the development of data and analytics solutions to support readiness outcomes in support of the Fleet Data Analytics Office.
You will create value through data exploitation; envisioning development and implementation of data-enabled strategies; enabling business outcomes through analytics and aiding in enterprise information policy.
You will identify and define data and analytics investments and identify opportunities for new data and AI products.
You will ensure analytic projects are designed to deliver improved readiness outcomes by demonstrating clear alignment to business value drivers.
You will work with business partners to understand business priorities, identify strategic initiatives, and develop effective and timely analytic solutions.
You will operationalize the most urgent data and analytics initiatives for data and analytics initiatives.

Requirements

Help

Conditions of employment

Must be a US Citizen.
Must be determined suitable for federal employment.
Must participate in the direct deposit pay program.
New employees to the Department of the Navy will be required to successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, visit e-verify.gov
Generally, current federal employees applying for GS jobs must serve at least one year at the next lower grade level. This requirement is called time-in-grade. Time-in-grade requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.
Within the Department of Defense (DoD), the appointment of retired military members within 180 days immediately following retirement date to a civilian position is subject to the provisions of 5 United States Code 3326.
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service.
You will be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.
This position may require travel from normal duty station to CONUS and OCONUS and may include remote or isolated sites. You must be able to travel on military and commercial aircraft for extended periods of time.
You will be required to obtain and maintain a U.S. Passport.

Qualifications

Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-13
grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following:

Experience applying data science, statistical analysis, mathematical modeling, database management, and information-technology infrastructure to complex organizational problems.
Experience developing and executing comprehensive data and AI strategies aligned to organizational missions, priorities, and long-range objectives.
Experience designing and implementing data use cases, including data collection, storage and retrieval, integration, transformation, modeling, pattern recognition, and visualization.
Experience using quantitative methods and programming languages such as Python or R, along with visualization tools such as Qlik, to analyze large datasets and develop predictive models.
Experience translating complex analytic results into clear executive-ready reports, dashboards, charts, recommendations, and briefings; mentoring users and teams on analytics tools and best practices.

Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

Additional information

This position is covered by the Department of Defense Priority Placement Program.

Additional vacancies may be filled by this announcement.

A tentative offer of employment will be rescinded if the selectee fails to meet the pre-employment requirements, including failure to report to any of the scheduled appointments.

During the application process you will have the ability to opt-in to make your resume available to hiring managers in the agency who have similar positions in the local commuting area. Depending on the hiring organization and the position being filled, job requirements (e.g., security clearance, travel, drug testing, financial disclosure filing, bargaining unit status, etc.) may vary. Other hiring managers filling similar positions may offer relocation expense reimbursement and/or may offer recruitment incentives for new employees, depending on funding availability and in accordance with policy. If you opt-in and are referred on a certificate, your resume will be available to other hiring managers for 180-days from the date the job announcement closes. Opting in does not impact your application for this announcement, nor does it guarantee further consideration for additional positions.

Federal annuitant information: The selection of an annuitant is subject to the Department of Defense and Department of the Navy policy on the employment of annuitants. Policy information may be found at: http://www.secnav.navy.mil/donhr/Documents/CivilianJobs/FedCivAnnuitants.pdf

This position requires evening and weekend work.

PPP applicants will be placed at the FPL, if determined Well Qualified (WQ). To receive priority consideration, the FPL must be the same grade level or equivalent of the retained grade or the grade held immediately prior to separation.

ICTAP Applicants: To be considered well-qualified and exercise selection priority as an ICTAP candidate, displaced Federal employees must satisfy all qualification requirements for the position and receive a rating in the highly qualified category (score 85) or higher. ICTAP candidates must provide copies of all of the following documentation at the time of application: 1) agency notice; 2) most recent performance appraisal; and 3) most recent SF-50 or notification of personnel action that includes position, grade level, and duty location. Summary

Organizational Location: This position is with the Department of Homeland Security, within U.S. Customs and Border Protection, Office of Human Resources Management, Strategic Transformation Management Division, in the following locations: Indianapolis, IN Minneapolis, MN Washington, D.C. Additional selections may be made for other organizational divisions and/or units within the duty location(s) listed above.

Duties

In this position you will serve as an Operations Research Analyst supporting CBP Human Resources Management strategic transformation initiatives through quantitative analysis, performance management, investment prioritization, and resource allocation for HR technology. Provides technical expertise and actionable recommendations to strengthen governance, improve business processes, and inform executive decision-making. This position starts at a salary of $125,776.00 (GS-14, Step 1) to $163,514.00 (GS-14, Step 10) GS Salary: Visit this link to view the locality pay tables by geographic area. If you do not see your geographic area listed, select the "Rest of United States" pay table. Some positions fall under a special pay rate depending on the series, grade level and location of the position. Please visit this link to view special pay rate charts. Salary: Salary listed reflects the rest of U.S. scale and, if applicable, will be adjusted to meet the locality pay or cost of living expenses of the duty location upon selection. Major Duties: Leading advanced operations research analyses to inform strategic planning and critical investment prioritization within the Human Resources (HR) technology portfolio. Developing and refining sophisticated mathematical models, scoring methodologies, and trade-off analyses to evaluate technological initiatives, system enhancements, and competing investment options. Provide authoritative analytical leadership and technical guidance to government and contractor personnel, ensuring all methodologies adhere to federal guidelines and best practices. Design and oversee the implementation of comprehensive performance measurement frameworks and dashboards to monitor key indicators such as processing efficiency, system reliability, and service quality. Prepare and present compelling, data-driven briefings to senior leadership to support evidence-based decision-making regarding resource allocation and portfolio management. CBP employees demonstrate the highest level of commitment to protect and serve the United States of America and to exemplify the CBP Core Values of Vigilance, Service to Country and Integrity. Learn more about CBP's mission, core values and careers at https://www.cbp.gov/about

Requiremennts

You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this position Males born after 12/31/1959 must be registered with Selective Service Primary U.S. residency for at least three of the last five years (additional details below) All pre-employment processes will be conducted in English You may be required to pass a background investigation CBP follows the DHS Drug-Free Workplace Plan for drug testing procedures As an employee of CBP, you will be joining a workforce that is dedicated to accomplishing our mission while maintaining the trust of our Nation by strictly adhering to all government ethics standards. Your conduct will be subject to the ethics rules applicable to all Executive Branch employees, and to CBP employees specifically, as well as the criminal conflict of interest statutes. Once you enter on duty, these rules include obtaining approval for outside employment or business activity, to ensure such employment or business activity is not prohibited and does not interfere or conflict with performance of your official duties. Please review further details via the following link. DHS uses E-Verify, an internet-based system, to confirm the eligibility of all newly hired employees to work in the United States. Learn more about E-Verify including your rights and responsibilities. Bargaining Unit: This position is not covered under the bargaining unit.

Qualifications

Basic Requirements: Education: Degree in operations research; or at least 24 semester hours in a combination of operations research, mathematics, probability, statistics, mathematical logic, science, or subject-matter courses requiring substantial competence in college-level mathematics or statistics. At least 3 of the 24 semester hours must have been in calculus. You qualify for this position if you meet one of the basic requirements, as described above and one year of specialized experience listed below. Experience GS-14: You qualify for the GS-14 grade level if you possess 1 year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, performing duties such as: Applying advanced operations research theories, principles, and methodologies-including statistical analysis, mathematical modeling, simulation, and optimization-to solve complex organizational problems. Using advanced analytical tools and business intelligence platforms such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, to design, develop, and maintain complex analytical models and performance measurement frameworks. Leading the integration and analysis of requirements, business processes, and operational workflows across multiple technology products or systems. Conducting risk identification, probability and impact assessments, and developing proactive mitigation strategies for major technological initiatives. Communicating highly complex analytical results and strategic recommendations to senior management or diverse stakeholders to influence decision-making and gain consensus. NOTE: Your resume must explicitly indicate how you meet this requirement, otherwise you will be found ineligible. Please see the "Required Documents" section below for additional resume requirements. Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. You must: Meet all qualification requirements, including education if applicable to this position, subject to verification at any stage of the application process; and Meet all applicable Time in Grade requirements (current federal employees must have served 52 weeks at the next lower grade or equivalent grade band in the federal service) by 10/30/2026. The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) must authorize employment offers made to current or former political appointees. If you are currently, or have been within the last 5 years, a political Schedule A, Schedule C, Non-career SES or Presidential Appointee employee in the Executive Branch, you must disclose this information to the Human Resources Office. Background Investigation: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is a federal law enforcement agency that requires all applicants to undergo a thorough background investigation prior to employment in order to promote the agency's core values of vigilance, service to country, and integrity. During the screening and/or background investigation process, you will be asked questions regarding any felony criminal convictions or current felony charges, the use of illegal drugs (e.g., marijuana, cocaine, heroin, LSD, methamphetamines, ecstasy), and the use of non-prescribed controlled substances including any experimentation, possession, sale, receipt, manufacture, cultivation, production, transfer, shipping, trafficking, or distribution of controlled substances. For additional information on the preemployment process, review the following link: Applicant Resources | CBP Careers Residency: There is a residency requirement for all applicants not currently employed by CBP. Individuals are required to have physically resided in the United States or its protectorates (as declared under international law) for at least three of the last five years. If you do not meet the residency requirement and you have been physically located in a foreign location for more than two of the last five years, you may request an exception to determine if you are eligible for a residency waiver by meeting one or more of the following conditions: Working for the U.S. Government as a federal civilian or as a member of the military A dependent who was authorized to accompany a federal civilian or member of the military who was working for the U.S. government Participation in a study abroad program sponsored by a U.S. affiliated college or university Working as a contractor, intern, consultant or volunteer supporting the U.S. government Probationary Period: All employees new to the federal government must serve a one year probationary period during the first year of his/her initial permanent federal appointment to determine fitness for continued employment. Current and former federal employees may be required to serve or complete a probationary period. Agency Career Transition Assistance Program (CTAP) or the Interagency Career Transition Assistance Program (ICTAP) Eligibles: If you have never worked for the federal government, you are not CTAP/ICTAP eligible. View information about CTAP/ICTAP eligibility on OPM's Career Transition Resources website. To be considered well qualified under CTAP/ICTAP, you must be rated at a minimum score of 85 for this position. In addition, you must submit the supporting documents listed under the Required Documents section of this announcement. The Department of Homeland Security encourages persons with disabilities to apply, to include persons with intellectual, severe physical or psychiatric disabilities, as defined by 5 CFR

213.3102(u), and/or Disabled Veterans with a compensable service-connected disability of 30 percent or more as defined by 5 CFR
315.707. Veterans, Peace Corps/VISTA volunteers, and persons with disabilities possess a wealth of unique talents, experiences, and competencies that can be invaluable to the DHS mission. If you are a member of one of these groups, you may not have to compete with the public for federal jobs. To determine your eligibility for non-competitive appointment and to understand the required documentation, click on the links above or contact the Servicing Human Resources Office listed at the bottom of this announcement.

Education

Please see the Qualifications and Required Documents sections for more information if education is applicable to this position. Your transcripts: All applicants are required to submit a copy of your college transcript (unofficial is acceptable at this time; however, official copies will be required prior to entrance on duty) or a list of coursework with hours completed provided from the institution. If you are a current CBP employee within the position series announced, transcripts will not be required at the time of application; however, education will be verified if you are selected and you may be required to submit transcripts at that time. Education must be from an institution accredited by an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education. Education obtained from a foreign university or college is not creditable unless it has been evaluated by an organization that specializes in interpretation of education credentials. Note: If submitting documentation of an evaluation, transcripts are still required. For a listing of some accrediting agencies see NACES | Credentials Evaluations Provided by NACES Members. See Recognition of Foreign Qualifications for more information. Please upload your resume under the "Resume" document type. Any other relevant supporting documents should be uploaded u

jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
DST Business Analyst and Business Intelligence Developer - Husky (Guindy,Chennai)

Id:
21074

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

The DST Business Analyst and Business Intelligence Developer for Husky will be responsible for designing, delivering, and maintaining the company’s enterprise business intelligence ecosystem, leveraging both internal and external data sources. This role will lead the development and support of enterprise-wide BI applications, data models, and analytics architecture. Working closely with senior business and IT stakeholders, the position will translate strategic data and information requirements into actionable solutions that enable data-driven decision making.

The incumbent will address complex technical challenges, optimize performance across BI platforms, and define data elements that drive meaningful insights and measurable business value. The role will also establish testing standards, develop and deliver training programs to enhance user adoption, and promote self‑service analytics. Additionally, this position will define governance standards, policies, and procedures for BI tools and data structures, establish data quality metrics, and evaluate emerging technologies to support continuous improvement of Husky’s enterprise BI capabilities.

Key Responsibilities & Key Success Metrics

Leading BI software development, deployment and maintenance
Perform Data Profiling and Data Analysis activities to understand data sources
Report curation, template definition and analytical data modeling
Work with cross-functional teams to gather and document reporting requirements
Translate business requirements into specifications that will be used to implement the required reports and dashboards, created from potentially multiple data sources
Identifies and resolves data reporting issues in a timely fashion, while looking for continuous improvement opportunities.
Build solutions that create value and resolve business problems
Provide technical guidance to designers and other stakeholders
Work effectively with members of Digital Solutions Team
Troubleshoots analytics tool problems and tunes for performance
Develops semantic layer and analytics query objects for end users
Translation of business questions and requirements into reports, views, and analytics query objects
Ensuring that quality standards are met
Supporting Master Data Management Strategy

Qualifications:

Technical Skills & Experience

Strong understanding of ERP and operational system data structures, with the ability to interpret, navigate, and optimize complex relational databases.
Advanced proficiency in writing high‑performance SQL queries against large‑scale, complex datasets, including optimization and troubleshooting.
Hands‑on experience in data visualization, dashboard design, and data storytelling, with the ability to translate analytical insights into clear, compelling, and actionable narratives.
Experience designing, debugging, and deploying BI solutions within an Azure DevOps (ADO) environment, including CI/CD practices, version control, and release management.
Proficiency with the Microsoft BI Stack, including:
Power BI (data modeling, DAX, visualization best practices, Power BI Service)
SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS/AAS)—tabular model development, optimization, and deployment

Experience working with Azure Data Platform services such as Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse Analytics, and Power BI Service.

Knowledge of Databricks or Microsoft Fabric is considered a strong asset.

Business & Functional Knowledge

Basic understanding of manufacturing and sales business processes, with the ability to translate operational requirements into analytical solutions.
Experience working in an international or distributed business environment, collaborating across regions and time zones.

Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills

Strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to interpret requirements, profile data, validate output, and ensure accuracy across BI solutions.
Adept at diagnosing data inconsistencies, performance issues, and modeling challenges, proposing effective, scalable solutions.

Communication & Collaboration

Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of conveying technical concepts to business stakeholders in clear, understandable terms.
Ability to facilitate meetings, workshops, and design sessions, enabling effective collaboration and informed decision-making.
Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams, including Data Engineering, Business Analysts, and business partners.

Language Requirements

Proficiency in English is required.
Knowledge of German or French is considered an asset.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.
