Job Description

Strategic Project Manager to lead the replacement of its legacy probation case management system.
This role bridges technical infrastructure, legislative and policy compliance, and the daily experience of probation officers and staff.
The position will operate within a multi-level governance framework, supporting executive decision-making, managing stakeholder alignment, and facilitating issue escalation across business, technology, and�leadership.

Strategic leadership and governance

Lead the full project lifecycle, from requirements and procurement through design, build, data migration, testing, statewide rollout, and decommissioning of ICON/JPOD.
Develop and maintain the master schedule, budget, scope baseline, and benefits realization plan.
Translate the Branch's strategic goals for probation into clear project objectives and measurable success criteria.

Vendor and procurement management

Support the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of a solution vendor under state procurement rules.
Hold vendors and internal teams accountable for quality, schedule, and cost.

Legislative and policy compliance

Track Colorado statutes, Chief Justice Directives, and probation standards affecting system requirements, and build them into the solution.
Coordinate with legal, policy, and research staff so the system supports required reporting, risk and needs assessments, and evidence-based practices.

Stakeholder engagement and change management

Engage chief probation officers, officers, supervisors, judges, court staff, and partner agencies across all districts, urban and rural alike.
Lead human-centered design activities, such as field observation, user testing, and feedback loops with frontline staff.
Direct organizational change management, training, communications, and go-live support.
Make sure the client-facing parts of the system are accessible, plain-language, and equitable for justice-involved individuals.

Risk, quality, and reporting

Identify, track, and mitigate risks and issues; escalate decisions promptly.
Plan cutover so probation supervision is never interrupted.
Report status, risks, and outcomes to leadership.

Minimum qualifications

Bachelor's degree in project management, information systems, public administration, criminal justice, business, or a related field. Additional relevant experience may substitute for the degree year for year.
Ten years of progressively responsible project management experience, including at least five years leading large, complex technology implementations with multiple vendors and stakeholder groups.
Demonstrated experience managing a multi-year schedule.
Experience leading enterprise system replacements that included data migration and organizational change management.
Ability to pass a criminal background check.

Preferred qualifications

Project Management Professional (PMP), PgMP, or equivalent certification.
Agile and change management certifications.
Experience with Waterfall Project methodology.
Experience applying Waterfall governance and procurement controls in conjunction with Agile solution delivery.
Experience implementing case management systems for courts, probation, parole, corrections, or other justice agencies.
Experience with commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) or configurable SaaS platform implementations in the public sector.
Experience working with geographically distributed users in both urban and rural settings.

Knowledge, skills, and abilities

Project and program management: command of predictive, Agile, and hybrid methods, and the judgment to choose between them.
Systems thinking: ability to understand how technology, policy, operations, and people interact, and to see downstream effects of design choices.
Communication: clear, plain-language writing and speaking for audiences ranging from judges and legislators to frontline officers and vendors.
Facilitation and influence: ability to build consensus among stakeholders with competing priorities, without direct authority.
Empathy for users: genuine interest in how probation officers and clients experience the system, and the discipline to design around their needs.
Analytical skills: ability to interpret data, evaluate trade-offs, and make sound decisions under uncertainty.
Integrity and discretion: sound handling of confidential criminal justice information and sensitive organizational matters.
Resilience: steady leadership through ambiguity, setbacks, and the pressures of a high-visibility public project.
Benefits orientation: understanding of business outcomes and the ability to support measurement of adoption and value realization objectives.
Governance and executive engagement: ability to operate within complex governance structures, prepare executive decision materials, facilitate escalations, and support leadership decision-making across multiple organizational levels.
Change management: ability to support organizational readiness, stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and user adoption activities.

Teaching traditional academic classes or delivering subject-matter lectures.

Lowering standards to make students feel successful instead of helping them achieve real mastery.
Managing a team from behind a desk without regularly coaching students and Guides firsthand.
Preserving outdated practices simply because "that's how we've always done it."

Ensure every student consistently experiences Alpha's three promises by building high-performing Guides, delivering engaging life skills experiences, and maintaining uncompromising standards for student success.

Join the team building school around student growth

.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager based in Switzerland.

In this role, you will support the planning, coordination, and delivery of clinical research studies within a science-driven and collaborative environment. You will work closely with sponsors, cross-functional teams, vendors, and clinical sites to help ensure studies are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. You will coordinate site activation, patient recruitment, study documentation, and project milestones while helping manage risks and resolve operational challenges. Working alongside experienced project management leaders, you will develop your expertise in clinical trial delivery, stakeholder management, and structured project execution. This opportunity is ideal for a clinical research professional ready to take the next step in project management while contributing to meaningful scientific work. You will also have opportunities to strengthen your leadership, problem-solving, and process improvement skills as you grow in the role.

Accountabilities

Support the initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, control, and closure of assigned clinical research projects, ensuring adherence to approved budgets, scope, timelines, standard operating procedures (SOPs), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory requirements.
Serve, when assigned, as a primary point of contact for sponsors, vendors, internal teams, and other project stakeholders, helping manage expectations and maintain effective communication.
Coordinate tasks, resources, and deadlines across departments to support timely study delivery and effective prioritization of site activation activities.
Work with project coordinators, site start-up teams, regulatory and clinical resources, and vendor management to align site activation activities, supplies, and services with project timelines.
Monitor project milestones and site activation progress, escalate risks or delays to senior project management colleagues, and contribute to corrective and preventive actions.
Support resource planning, project status reporting, study tracker reconciliation, change control, risk management, and the maintenance of project quality standards.
Review and contribute to project plans, operational processes, study manuals, and other documentation required for effective project execution.
Help ensure that study documents and deliverables—including protocols, informed consent forms, electronic case report forms, clinical study reports, and related materials—meet applicable country-specific and study requirements.
Coordinate site feasibility and selection activities, qualification visits, patient recruitment tracking, site follow-up, and investigator meeting planning.
Support central ethics committee and regulatory submissions in collaboration with regulatory affairs teams, where applicable.
Ensure essential site documentation is collected and kept up to date, and assist with Trial Master File (TMF) quality reviews and audit or inspection readiness.
Support clinical monitoring activities, including training, monitoring visit documentation, follow-up letters, site issue escalation, and compliance with the monitoring plan.
Maintain project-specific training matrices and verify that team members complete required training before performing study-related tasks.
Coordinate with clinical sites to help ensure the availability of investigational products, study supplies, laboratory kits, equipment, and other materials needed to conduct the study.
Collaborate with data management teams to support protocol-aligned case report forms, query resolution, data review, and database lock timelines.
Contribute to departmental training, technical knowledge sharing, and process improvement initiatives under the guidance of senior project management staff.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field related to clinical research or a comparable discipline.
At least three years of experience in a similar role, including clinical study management activities within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or Contract Research Organization (CRO) industry.
At least two years of experience coordinating clinical trial management activities.
Strong knowledge of GCP and International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) standards, as well as relevant U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and Canadian regulatory requirements.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and the ability to prepare accurate project documentation and reports.
Excellent written and spoken English; French language skills are an advantage.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships with sponsors, colleagues, vendors, and clinical site teams.
Good organizational and problem-solving abilities, including the capacity to manage competing priorities and deliver against demanding timelines.
Experience managing small to medium-sized projects using a structured and disciplined project management approach.
Understanding of core project management principles and the ability to develop and deliver resource-based project plans.
Strong teamwork and people management skills, including experience coordinating teams in a matrix environment.
A proactive, detail-oriented approach to quality, compliance, stakeholder coordination, and continuous learning.
Legal authorization to work in the eligible hiring region is required; the original posting specifies applicants who can legally work in the EU. Switzerland-specific eligibility should be confirmed before applying.

Benefits

Permanent, full-time position.
Flexible working schedule to support work-life balance.
Vacation allowance.
Home-based working arrangement, subject to role and location eligibility.
Ongoing learning, training, and professional development opportunities.
A stimulating, science-driven environment with collaborative colleagues.
Opportunities to develop clinical project management expertise and progress professionally.
Work that contributes to clinical research and the development of meaningful medical advances.

You will work closely with sponsors, cross-functional teams, vendors, and clinical sites to help ensure studies are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. Support the initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, control, and closure of assigned clinical research projects, ensuring adherence to approved budgets, scope, timelines, standard operating procedures (SOPs), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory requirements.

Contribute to departmental training, technical knowledge sharing, and process improvement initiatives under the guidance of senior project management staff.

Strong knowledge of GCP and International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) standards, as well as relevant U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and Canadian regulatory requirements.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and the ability to prepare accurate project documentation and reports.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships with sponsors, colleagues, vendors, and clinical site teams.
Good organizational and problem-solving abilities, including the capacity to manage competing priorities and deliver against demanding timelines.
Experience managing small to medium-sized projects using a structured and disciplined project management approach.
Understanding of core project management principles and the ability to develop and deliver resource-based project plans.
Strong teamwork and people management skills, including experience coordinating teams in a matrix environment.
A proactive, detail-oriented approach to quality, compliance, stakeholder coordination, and continuous learning.

What You'll Do

As a Staff Program Manager in Product Operations, you will run the financial operations that keep Teradata's product organization licensed, funded, and accountable for spend. You will own day-to-day execution across software purchasing, cloud FinOps, cross-charges, and budget tracking, and you will run the controls and reporting that leaders use to make spend decisions. Based in India, you will work closely with global Product, Engineering, Finance, and Procurement stakeholders.

Software purchasing and PO operations: Own the end-to-end purchasing cycle for product software, tooling, and services, from usage analysis and vendor quotes through requisitions in Oracle Fusion, approval routing, contract signature, PO issuance, receipting, and invoice resolution.
Renewals and licensing: Maintain the product software license and renewal register, surface renewals well before term end, and work with Procurement and system owners to confirm options, terms, and required license quantities.
FinOps and cloud-spend execution: Track R&D cloud spend against budget across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, prepare recurring spend reporting, validate cloud provider invoices and marketplace offers, and coordinate savings plan and commitment purchases while monitoring realized savings.
Cloud cost optimization: Coordinate cost optimization workstreams, including account decommissioning and transfers, tagging and cost allocation, and follow-through with product and engineering owners on savings actions.
Cross-charge and budget tracking: Track cloud, tooling, and software budgets and outlooks, validate and reconcile monthly cross-charges and chargebacks between departments, and reconcile monthly against Finance records with clear variance explanations.
Planning cycles: Support annual budgeting and quarterly outlooks by working with budget owners and Finance on spend assumptions, license requirements, and forecast changes.
Operational controls: Run controls over purchasing and spend, including approval hierarchy checks, complete cost center and GL coding, confirmation of delivery before receipting, and audit-ready records.
Reporting and follow-through: Produce recurring reports and dashboards for Product Operations and product leadership, and drive open actions, missing data, and blockers to closure.

Finance partners on budgets, outlooks, cross-charges, and monthly reconciliation.
Procurement on supplier engagement, contract renewals, purchase orders, and invoice resolution.
Product and Engineering leaders, budget owners, and system owners on spend ownership, license requirements, and cost optimization actions.
Cloud FinOps and cloud operations teams on spend data, tagging, cost allocation, and savings initiatives.
Software vendors, resellers, and cloud service providers on quotes, order forms, and billing.
US-based Product Operations leadership during a regular daily overlap with US business hours.

Collaborate with colleagues who share a commitment to leveraging AI responsibly, ensuring our people and customers benefit from the opportunities AI creates.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

6+ years in procurement operations, software asset management, FinOps, or financial operations, including at least 3 years in enterprise software, cloud, or technology companies.
Hands-on procure-to-pay experience in an ERP such as Oracle Fusion, including requisitions, approval workflows, purchase orders, receipts, and invoice matching.
Working knowledge of public cloud billing and cost management on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including invoice validation, savings plans or commitments, and cost allocation.
Demonstrated experience with budget and forecast tracking, variance analysis, and cross-charge or chargeback reconciliation with Finance.
Advanced Excel skills and experience building recurring reports or dashboards in Power BI or similar tools.
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to drive follow-up across functions and time zones and escalate issues early.
Ability to work a schedule that provides a regular daily overlap with US business hours.
Foundational AI skills and the ability to understand how AI can be applied to improve outcomes in your area of expertise.

FinOps Certified Practitioner or a comparable certification.
Experience supporting US-based stakeholders from India or another global location.
Familiarity with software licensing models, renewal negotiations, and contract signature workflows such as DocuSign.
Experience with Smartsheet, Jira, or similar work management tools.
A controls mindset: you keep records complete, approvals documented and spend auditable.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; you keep spend data tidy and stakeholders informed.
Ability to build trust quickly with budget owners, engineers, and Finance partners; seen as a reliable execution partner rather than process overhead.
A passion for how AI can unlock potential to help our teams, our customers, and our communities achieve great things.

new_jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

About The Job You're Considering

We are looking for a senior Oracle Cloud Program Manager to lead large, complex Oracle Cloud SaaS programs across Financials (ERP), SCM, HCM, EPM and CX. You will own delivery end to end for multi-pillar, multi-country deployments, leading onshore and offshore techno-functional teams and acting as the client's main point of contact for the program.

This role is built to grow. As you prove yourself on flagship programs, you will take on a portfolio of projects at one or more clients, with accountability for delivery assurance, margin, client satisfaction and account growth. You will work alongside sales and solution teams to shape new work and become a trusted advisor to client executives up to C-level.

Program Managers are responsible for overseeing the project/engagement/contract/activity on a daily basis and are responsible for delivering high-quality results within the identified objectives and constraints, ensuring the effective use of the allocated resources. They are responsible for risk and issue management, project/engagement communication and stakeholder management. Project managers perform the activities of planning, organising, securing, monitoring and managing the resources and work necessary to deliver specific project goals and objectives in an effective and efficient way. Responsible for leading either a large contractorengagement or a definable segment of a very large and complex contractorengagement. Clients may be external or internal. PM are responsible for the translation of the clients complex business requirements into formal agreements. For these, PM establish specific solutions, applications or processes which ultimately culminate in customer acceptance of the results. This includes working with client team members and executives to identify business requirements and subsequently working with, and leading others, in the initiating, planning, controlling, executing and closing the clients solution. PM are responsible for a wide range of process activities beginning with the request for proposal through development, and final delivery.

Your Role

Program delivery

Lead large, multi-pillar Oracle Cloud SaaS programs through all phases, from design workshops to go-live and post-implementation support
Deliver every program on time, on budget and to agreed quality, with clear progress reporting on deliverables and milestones
Direct onshore and offshore functional and technical teams, making sure delivery best practices are followed and work products are high quality
Run detailed planning, effort estimation and progress tracking, and hold the team to the project plan
Guide clients on process and configuration decisions, and drive change through negotiation and consensus-building
Own scope, risk and change management, including raising and negotiating change requests
Drive all client and project governance meetings, and act as the escalation point for the client
Use AI-enabled tools and delivery accelerators to improve productivity and quality

Portfolio and commercial leadership
(grows over time)

Take on executive oversight of a portfolio of Oracle Cloud projects across one or more clients
Own project financials, including margin, revenue and bookings forecasting, and contribution margin improvement plans
Support delivery assurance, solution reviews and deal reviews
Plan resource assignment and demand across the portfolio
Build long-term client relationships and senior stakeholder trust, up to C-level
Spot and qualify add-on opportunities in existing accounts, and help close them with sales and solution teams
Contribute to pursuits with proposals, estimates, win themes and client presentations
Coach and develop consultants and project managers, and help build Oracle Cloud skills across the team
Contribute to Capgemini's Oracle Cloud community through offers, solutions, accelerators and knowledge sharing

Your Skills And Experience

12+ years in the Oracle applications ecosystem, including multiple full life cycle implementations
Project or program manager on at least 5–6 Oracle Cloud (Fusion) implementations, including at least one large, multi-pillar or multi-country program
Hands-on knowledge of Oracle Cloud SaaS across at least two of ERP Financials, SCM, HCM, EPM and CX
Proven record of delivering on time, on budget and to quality, with ownership of project financials and margin
Experience leading onshore and offshore teams in global delivery models
Strong client management, with experience working with senior and C-level stakeholders
Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills
Bachelor's degree in business, IT or a related field

Nice to have

Experience overseeing several projects at once, or a portfolio within a major account
Track record of growing revenue in existing accounts and supporting sales pursuits
PMP, PgMP, Prince2 or Oracle Cloud certifications
Experience using AI tools to improve delivery productivity

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.

What You'll Do

We are thrilled to announce an opening for an onsite Operations Project Lead to join our dynamic team in Duluth, GA!

The Operations Program Manager (OPM) leads multi-functional production program teams. They are accountable to the Business Area for timely delivery of products to both external and internal customers. This role is a unique and rewarding position, combining aspects of manufacturing, product engineering, and program management. Security Operations & Incident Command: Manage daily SOC monitoring capabilities, detection platforms, and incident triage workflows across critical IT and OT environments. Act as Incident Manager during major cyber security incidents, directing technical containment, executive briefings, and post-incident root cause analysis.
Continuous Capability Uplift & Automation: Drive the ongoing optimisation of detection logic, threat intelligence integration, and automated SOAR playbooks to lower MTTD and MTTR. Stay ahead of emerging threat vectors, including AI-related vulnerabilities and critical infrastructure risks.
Resilience & Disaster Preparedness: Partner with the Risk and Governance teams to conduct regular BCP/DR tabletop exercises, refine operational response playbooks, and ensure multi-tiered response readiness.

Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, mentor, and foster capability within a growing operational team (4–5 direct reports), cultivating a continuous learning environment, operational excellence, and team sustainability.
Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement: Track SOC operational metrics and KPIs, preparing clear, strategic briefs and presentations for senior management, executive leadership, and board-level visibility.

About the location:

This role is based in Melbourne.

About You

Proven Operational Leadership: Demonstrated leadership experience running a modern SOC or technical incident response team within an enterprise environment (e.g., banking/financial services, critical infrastructure, utilities, transport, FMCG, or top-tier consultancy).
Strong Technical Foundation: Extensive background working your way through technical cyber roles with practical depth across SIEM, EDR/XDR, SOAR, threat intelligence, and network detection technologies.
Inquisitive Problem Solver: A naturally curious mindset with a proactive drive to investigate complex issues, explore alternative paths, and implement sustainable solutions.
Decisive Crisis Leader: Calm and structured under pressure, with proven experience commanding major cyber incident responses and managing operational handoffs.
Executive Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to distill technical complexity into actionable insights for senior executives and diverse business stakeholders.
Qualifications & Certifications: Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, GIAC) or degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, or Information Technology are highly regarded, though deep practical enterprise experience is prioritized.
Safety & Values Driven: Demonstrated commitment to safety leadership, ethical conduct, collaboration, and mutual accountability.

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role

Join us on our mission to help everyone shape the tools that shape their lives.

At Notion, we believe in building software that adapts to how people work, not the other way around. As we scale globally, we need someone who can ensure our revenue teams are equipped with the knowledge, tools, and processes to succeed across every geography while maintaining our core values and approach to customer relationships.

We're looking for a Revenue Enablement Program Manager to own the development and implementation of global enablement programs that scale seamlessly across regions. You'll spend 50% of your time developing and locally implementing these global programs, and 50% tuning enablement initiatives to meet regional needs—all while maintaining a globally aligned selling process that honors local market nuances.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, requiring someone who can think globally while acting locally. You'll leverage AI and automation to build scalable enablement solutions that empower our revenue teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences worldwide.

What you'll achieve

Global Program Development & Implementation (50%)

Champion our global operating cadence to ensure the Japan and Korea region is successfully executing our GTM strategy as an extension of the Global Revenue Operations team
Design, develop and manage comprehensive enablement programs that can be deployed globally while maintaining consistency in our selling methodology and GTM goals
Partner with Revenue Operations, Sales Leadership, and Product Marketing to create scalable training curriculum, design content, program manage SME stakeholders, develop certification programs, deploy continuous training frameworks frameworks and more
Build and maintain our global sales playbook, ensuring it reflects best practices that work across diverse markets
Leverage AI tools and automation to create personalized learning paths, real-time coaching recommendations for revenue team members and leverage the work of our Enablement team
Establish measurement frameworks to track program effectiveness and ROI across all regions — you'll close the loop and report out on progress
Lead cross-functional initiatives to align product releases, go-to-market strategies, and enablement rollouts

Regional Tuning & Localization (50%)

Collaborate with regional sales and GTM leaders to identify local market dynamics, competitive landscapes, and customer behavior patterns
Adapt global programs to address regional needs while maintaining core methodology and brand consistency
Create region-specific content, case studies, and competitive battle cards that resonate with local markets
Build feedback loops between regional teams and global program development to continuously improve our approach
Support regional team leads in coaching and reinforcing enablement initiatives within their teams

About You

Experience & Expertise

7-10+ years of experience in sales enablement, revenue operations, or similar go-to-market roles
Proven track record of building and scaling enablement programs across multiple geographies
Expert in adult learning methodologies and creating compelling multimodal content
High proficiency with the enablement tool stack including emerging AI and automation solutions (ideally AI is already embedded into your workflow)
Experience working with global sales teams and understanding of diverse market dynamics
Strong analytical skills with experience measuring program impact and ROI

Strategic thinker who can balance global consistency with local relevance
Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable working with senior leadership
Natural collaborator who thrives in cross-functional environments
Data-driven approach to decision making with strong attention to detail
Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-growing environment
Passionate about developing people and helping teams reach their potential
Fluency in Japanese and English

Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred), learning management systems, and sales enablement platforms
Proficiency with AI tools for content creation, data analysis, and process automation
Strong project management skills with experience managing multiple initiatives simultaneously
Comfortable with sales analytics and performance metrics

Experience at a high-growth SaaS company
Background in sales, customer success, or revenue-generating roles
International work experience or familiarity with diverse cultural business practices
Experience with Notion or similar productivity tools
Certification in sales methodologies (MEDDIC, Challenger, etc.)
Fluency in Korean

, a division of Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, provides workplace financial solutions that build employee financial confidence, foster loyalty and help our corporate clients attract and retain top talent. Our end-to-end offering spans Equity, Financial Wellness and Retirement Solutions. Plus, we provide all employees with Financial Empowerment, so they have the knowledge, tools and support needed to make the most of their workplace financial benefits.

What you’ll be part of – our Morgan Stanley at Work culture:

At Morgan Stanley at Work, we walk the talk. We have created a place for our employees to learn, achieve and grow – a place for people to build a career where you can thrive both personally and professionally. We are passionate about exceeding our clients’ expectations and helping them succeed. We are fearless in taking on new challenges that deliver exceptional results. We believe amazing things can happen when we work together in an environment where everybody has a true sense of belonging and their ideas are heard.

We value differences and are committed to providing a work environment where our people can do their best work. We look for people who are problem solvers, empathetic listeners, team players and inclusive leaders. We are committed to your growth and development, and your entire employee experience. We recognize that our people and culture are the keys to our success. We invite you to explore how you can be an integral part of our team.

Shareworks by Morgan Stanley
and Equity Edge Online® (EEO)
are key offerings within our Equity Solutions pillar. These offerings combine cutting-edge technology, outstanding client service, streamlined administration, and global plan management. Shareworks provides clear and actionable ways to make equity plans more personal, so employees at all levels of a company can fully experience the many benefits of shared ownership. It simplifies the complexities of equity plan management, while helping employees realize the full potential of their benefits. As its name implies, Equity Edge Online gives companies an edge in equity plan management. It delivers powerful functionality that elevates performance and efficiency, motivating workforces to realize the full value of their awards and benefits – no matter where they are on their financial journey.

Role Overview

The Onboarding Project Manager will be part of the U.S. Public Equity Solutions group within the Morgan Stanley at Work organization. U.S. Public Equity Solutions service group is responsible for the engagement, onboarding, and day to day service management of corporate clients and their equity administration plan terms and associated service offerings. The candidate will work cross-functionally towards a goal of successful end-to-end delivery of onboarding projects bringing a willingness to do what it takes to get onboarding projects done in a timely and accurate manner. The candidate will build exceptional relationships with both immediate and cross-functional teams and thrive in a fast-paced and evolving environment focusing on all aspects of client readiness and support for clients as they move through the full lifecycle of implementation activities onto the Morgan Stanley at Work equity administration platforms.

This position is responsible for the successful management of several concurrent projects. Projects include the implementation of Stock Plan Administration and Employee Broker Services for corporate clients in a timely and high-quality fashion. The Project Manager will manage the client relationship, ensuring that they and other team members understand and perform their responsibilities, maintain a high level of client satisfaction and continuously assess project risks.

This highly visible position involves interacting with a variety of individuals internally and externally and at all levels of the organization. Candidate must be driven and a self-starter, be organized and detail-oriented, and have excellent communication skills.

What You Will Do In The Role

Responsible for the successful end to end delivery of Client Onboarding projects, including but not limited to:

Serving as the primary contact for assigned corporate clients throughout the onboarding process, maintaining a client-focused, yet firm approach.
Using established tools & processes, act as the key contact between new clients and internal stakeholders to establish project requirements and timelines
Engaging in scoping and requirements gathering, understanding customer requirements and relaying them back to the onboarding technical specialist and/or or software development team where appropriate.
Establishing and meeting goals, assign and direct the work of others, and manage multiple requests with minimal direction.
Enforcing project schedules, deadlines and standards.
Leading project reviews to assess schedule, processes, assess risks and facilitate communication and negotiation.
Providing regular reporting to applicable managers, executive team, and the client as required.
Auditing, monitoring and leading the correction process to ensure project and resource data is maintained consistently in accordance with standards and methodologies.
Actively participating in resolution of issues and conflicts, internally as well as with clients and other vendors where appropriate; escalating issues in an appropriate, timely, and tactful manner

What You Will Bring To The Role

2+ years’ experience in stock plan benefits and/or financial services
Strong client engagement skills with Fortune 500 companies
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance or similar field is preferred
PMP Certification or in process of working towards its completion
Certified Equity Professional designation, strongly preferred
In depth knowledge of Equity Compensation
Brokerage Industry Knowledge, preferred
Ability to travel up to 10% of the time
Leadership: Able to take charge and lead projects with minimal supervision or follow-up. Leads by example and models the way for the broader team
Business Knowledge: Exhibits depth of knowledge relative to equity plan administration and recordkeeping software applications
Analytical Skills: Utilizes well-developed problem-solving skills necessary to research and trouble shoot inquiries through continual interaction with all departments.
Decisiveness: Able to make good quality decisions based on a mixture of analysis, wisdom, experience, and judgment.
Program & Project Management/ Support: Shows strong organization skills and project management disciplines. Reflects a strong understanding of the project management knowledge areas including scope definition, schedule development, resource planning, quality control, team development, communications, and risk management.
Communication: Has excellent written and verbal communication skills necessary to Interact with external clients and internal stakeholders
Client Relationship Building: Demonstrates ability to meet customer needs in a timely manner, building productive customer relationships and taking personal responsibility for customer satisfaction and loyalty.
Customer Focus: Clearly maintains a Customer Focus and is dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of both internal and external customers.
Resilience: Able to work under periods of high pressure with tight timeframes. Able to maintain composure under high stress situations. Maintains positive demeanor and able to ease tension.
Shareworks/Equity Edge Online and/or relative administrative software knowledge a plus
Salesforce and Jira application knowledge a plus
Strong knowledge and use of MS Office (Project, Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, Access & Outlook)

While we thank all applicants for their interest, please note that only those individuals selected for an interview will be contacted.

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

an exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior Project Manager to join a major national digital health technology program responsible for delivering critical application, infrastructure and cloud-based initiatives that support healthcare services used by millions of Australians.

Lead the successful delivery of complex application, infrastructure and cloud technology projects.

About Us

Court Services Victoria provides corporate services and facilities to support the performance of the judicial, quasi-judicial and administrative functions of Victoria's courts and tribunal, Judicial College and Judicial Commission.

Collectively, Victoria's Supreme, County, Magistrates', Children's, and Coroners courts, the Victorian Civil and Administrative Tribunal (VCAT), the Judicial College of Victoria, the Judicial Commission of Victoria, and Court Services Victoria (CSV) are referred to as the ‘Courts Group'.

Our people enable the Courts Group to deliver on each jurisdiction's own strategic priorities while also pursuing strategic opportunities that are interconnected and deliver benefits more broadly.

CCV

The County Court of Victoria is established pursuant to the County Court Act 1958. It has original and appellate jurisdiction and is the principal trial court in the State of Victoria. The Court hears over 12,000 criminal, common law, and commercial cases each year. The County Court has unlimited monetary jurisdiction in common law and commercial matters. In its criminal jurisdiction, the Court hears all indictable offences except treason, murder, and related offences.

There are a total of 80 Judges of the Court and over 300 staff, including judicial support staff. The County Court regularly conducts circuit sittings at 12 circuit courts situated in major centres throughout regional Victoria.

The County Court is committed to continuous improvement in accordance with the International Framework for Court Excellence. The Court's vision is to be a leader in court excellence, delivering the highest standard of justice to the community and inspiring public confidence in the rule of law.

About The Role

As Program Manager, Insights and Performance, you will lead the Court's data and insights function and play a key role in strengthening how information is used to support decision-making, organisational performance and continuous improvement. Reporting to the Executive Director, Priority Projects, you will lead a specialist team responsible for business intelligence, analytics and performance reporting across the organisation.

Working closely with jurisdictions, corporate business areas, technology teams and senior leaders, you will provide strategic leadership across the Court's approach to reporting, analysis and the use of information. You will lead improvement initiatives, provide trusted advice on performance and analytical matters, and help deliver practical, evidence-based solutions to complex organisational challenges. This is a significant leadership opportunity for someone who can combine sound judgement, strong stakeholder engagement and a clear focus on delivery in a complex operating environment.

Key Accountabilities Include

Leading the Court's Insights and Performance function, providing strategic direction and oversight for business intelligence, performance reporting, analytics, evaluation and data governance services that support organisational priorities and evidence-based decision-making.
Leading the delivery of the Court's data excellence capability strategic priority, driving organisational uplift in data literacy, governance, forecasting, evaluation, business intelligence and performance management to strengthen the Court's use of information as a strategic asset.
Providing authoritative strategic advice to executives, senior leaders and governance forums on data, reporting, performance and analytical matters, identifying opportunities, risks and emerging issues that may impact organisational outcomes.
Building and maintaining effective relationships with jurisdictions, corporate business areas, technology teams and external stakeholders to understand business priorities, influence outcomes and ensure data and insights services deliver measurable value.
Leading, developing and supporting a small high-performing team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement and evidence-based decision-making while building organisational capability in the effective use of data and insights.

About You

You are an experienced and credible leader with a strong background in business intelligence, analytics, reporting or performance in a complex organisation. You bring a strategic mindset, strong judgement and the ability to translate business priorities into practical and sustainable solutions.

You have a proven ability to build effective working relationships, influence at senior levels and lead teams through change. You are collaborative, thoughtful and outcomes-focused, with a strong understanding of how high-quality information can support planning, performance and service delivery. You will also bring demonstrated experience in reporting, dashboard development, data visualisation and tools such as Power BI, SQL and related analytics platforms.

resume

Job Description:

INTELLIGENCE ANALYST SME

The ASIA SME researches, identifies, and fuses available intelligence from all intelligence disciplines – HUMINT, SIGINT, GEOINT, OSINT/PAI, Cyber, and military reconnaissance – to draw conclusions, make inferences, and develop deep understanding spanning tactical to strategic relevance within their assigned portfolio. ASIA SMEs then use those conclusions, inferences, and deep understanding to produce intelligence products, to drive the intelligence cycle, to collaborate with counterparts in the Intel Community, to inform current/future operations, and to advise operational decision-makers. An ASIA SME serves as the lead analyst and technical expert with primary analytic responsibility over their assigned portfolio and may mentor/guide more junior analysts. An ASIA SME demonstrates subject matter expertise in proven analytic techniques and current analytic tools. They demonstrate expert-level proficiency in producing high-quality comprehensive technical/non-technical intelligence products (assessments, papers, presentations) and can prepare and present formal or informal briefings as required.

Employees must maintain global readiness and be available to deploy on a no-notice basis to hazardous duty/combat zones. Deployments may be to a theater of operations with permissive, uncertain, or hostile environments while living in austere conditions for extended periods.

Job Responsibilities:

The ASIA SME shall participate in the conduct of all-source intelligence analysis and production in direct support of the planning and execution of current/future global special operations or other operations in support of higher headquarters priorities and the National Defense Strategy.

ASIA SME's Shall Conduct The Following:

The planning, research, conduct, review, evaluation, and organization of intelligence analysis to support current or future operations. This will include capturing analytic insights and conclusions in appropriate knowledge and data management tools, as well as the management of Requests for Information.
The production of reports and assessments based on their analysis, in the form of articles, papers, studies, slides, and other media – making the analysis available throughout the Intelligence Community. This includes both informal products for internal use, as well as formal products for dissemination to a community of interest or the Intelligence Community (in compliance with applicable Intelligence Community publication standards).
The preparation and presentation of all-source intelligence briefings to leadership and other personnel within the unit and elsewhere within DoD and other Government agencies.
The identification of information gaps, followed by the coordination for codification of those gaps into intelligence and/or collection requirements to meet current and anticipated intelligence needs, as well as the evaluation of intelligence collected in response to requirements.
The conduct of analytic engagement with counterpart specialists throughout the unit, the Intelligence Community, and other Government agencies so that all sources of information are exploited. This will include real-time interface and communication with Combatant Command staffs and deployed U.S. forces to ensure that requirements are met.

Job Requirements
:

All-Source Intelligence Analyst Subject Matter Expert (ASIA SME) shall possess the following qualifications:

ASIA SME shall have a minimum of ten (10) years of experience performing analytical intelligence related operations while serving in an Intelligence Task Force, National Intelligence Support Team, National Military Joint Intelligence Center or Combatant Command, or, a non-DoD equivalent IA operational community.
The ASIA SME shall have not less than five (5) years of operational analysis experience in their analytical field working for or with national level intelligence agencies, such as NSA, CIA, or DIA.
At least three (3) years of experience and knowledge in the area of intelligence support to special operations.
Proficiency, knowledge, and experience with current all-source analytical techniques, theory, methodologies, processes, and trends.
At least five (5) years of current experience and knowledge of analytic tools developed within the last five (5) years.
At least three (3) years of experience writing formal finished intelligence assessments (e.g., white papers, targeting packages, or other serialized finished intelligence products).
At least four (4) years of experience preparing and delivering intelligence briefings at the Colonel (O-6) / GS-15 level or higher.
Current Top Secret clearance and SCI eligible.

new_jobs.title: AVP, Business Analyst, WRB Tech
new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced AVP Business Analyst to lead Back Office and trade-lifecycle analysis for complex Wealth Management and Financial Markets initiatives. The role bridges Front Office product and payoff understanding with downstream execution across validation, lifecycle processing, settlement, finance and accounting, reconciliation, trade controls and customer outputs.

The ideal candidate is a senior, hands-on Business Analyst with strong cross-asset product and payoff literacy, deep Back Office domain expertise, and the ability to shape solutions, challenge gaps and drive decisions across multi-system initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

Contribute cross-asset product, operations, finance, control and technology insights to Back Office and trade-lifecycle roadmaps, supporting prioritisation based on business value, operational readiness, risk and delivery feasibility.
Shape recommendations across complex or strategically important cross-platform initiatives, challenge assumptions and influence decisions through product expertise, end-to-end impact analysis and stakeholder alignment.

Business

Own Back Office and trade-lifecycle impact analysis for complex Wealth Management and Financial Markets product and platform initiatives across validation, settlement, finance and accounting, reconciliation, trade controls and customer outputs.
Translate Front Office product and payoff economics into clear, testable downstream requirements, including booking-model controls, lifecycle events, accounting entries, PSGL ChartFields, cash and settlement flows, and customer outputs.
Partner with Product Owners, operations, finance, engineering, architecture, quality engineering and business stakeholders to refine scope, resolve design gaps and prioritise the delivery backlog.
Assess cross-system impacts, dependencies, options and risks, including bifurcation versus non-bifurcation treatment across lifecycle, settlement, accounting and customer outputs.
Define and support SIT and UAT scenarios, expected results, data validation, reconciliation checks, defect triage, implementation readiness and post-release validation; create test cases where required.
Maintain traceability from business outcomes and product economics through requirements, controls, delivery, testing and acceptance.
Lead business analysis for complex, cross-system and strategically significant initiatives. Define the analysis approach, resolve ambiguity, manage competing stakeholder needs and own the quality and completeness of end-to-end lifecycle analysis.

Processes

Analyse current-state trade-lifecycle processes across booking hand-off, validation, lifecycle events, settlement, payments, accounting, reconciliation, controls and customer outputs, identifying opportunities for simplification, automation and control improvement.
Define future-state processes, business rules, data flows, accounting treatment, exception handling, reconciliation and operational impacts for new or enhanced capabilities.
Ensure process, requirement, decision, control and traceability artefacts remain current, consistent and accessible throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Lead end-to-end process analysis across functions, systems and markets, and influence agreement on material lifecycle, operating-model, accounting and control changes.

People & Talent

Provide functional guidance, coaching and quality oversight to Business Analysts working on related Back Office and trade-lifecycle initiatives.
Lead peer reviews and promote consistent business analysis standards, reusable assets and good practices.
Support capability development, onboarding and knowledge sharing across the chapter, including cross-asset product, trade lifecycle, settlement, finance and control knowledge.

Risk Management

Identify, assess, document, escalate and support resolution of delivery, operational, finance, conduct, regulatory, data and technology risks across the end-to-end trade lifecycle.
Anticipate material risks and control gaps across complex initiatives, challenge proposed approaches where required, and drive agreement on proportionate mitigation, ownership and closure.

Governance

Ensure all analysis, control, testing and assurance artefacts meet required standards and policies, including SCB Governance Standards and ESDLC.
Define and oversee the analysis governance approach for complex initiatives, assure the quality of key artefacts, and resolve significant lifecycle, accounting, settlement or control gaps before governance or delivery decisions.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

Influences senior and cross-functional stakeholders, resolves conflicting priorities and establishes alignment across complex initiatives.
Product Owners and business sponsors, for scope, requirements, value and prioritisation.
Operations, Finance, Product Control, Engineering Leads, Domain Tech Leads, Architects and Quality Engineering, for solution design, controls, testing and delivery.

Skills And Experience

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyse and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
Software Product Business Knowledge: Knowledge of and experience with the business aspects and operation of a software product; knowledge of the install base, current uses, future plans, and product vision.
Application Delivery Process: Knowledge of major tasks, deliverables, and formal application delivery methodologies; ability to utilize these in order to deliver new or enhanced applications.
Software Change Request Management: Knowledge of, and experience with, managing product change requests from customers, prospective customers, vendors, and internal staff.
Software Quality Assurance: Knowledge of software quality assurance activities, tasks, tools and techniques, and the ability to evaluate new or enhanced systems, software packages and software tools to ensure adherence to functionality and quality requirements.
Release Management: Knowledge of activities, practices, deliverables and application release techniques; ability to manage and control the implementation of new or enhanced applications into a production/live environment.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree, or higher, in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Training

Typically 12 or more years of relevant experience in business analysis or financial services technology, including leadership of complex, cross-system or cross-functional initiatives across Wealth Management or Financial Markets.
Strong Front Office product/payoff literacy, with ability to understand how pricing, payoff and lifecycle events drive downstream treatment.
Deep Back Office domain expertise in Financial Markets / Wealth Management products, especially complex derivatives and structured payoffs.
Working knowledge of trade validation, trade controls, lifecycle processing, settlement and reconciliation across multi-system environments.
Working knowledge of settlement and payment messaging, including SWIFT and ISO20022 concepts relevant to trade lifecycle and nostro / settlement processes.
Strong understanding of finance/accounting impacts, including PSGL, ChartFields, accounting entries, sub-ledger concepts and reconciliation requirements.
Clear understanding of customer outputs: advices, statements, confirmations, contract notes and how payoff economics should be represented.
Comfortable working system-agnostically across trading, core banking, settlement, finance, reconciliation and reporting platforms.
Hands-on analytical skills, including SQL or equivalent query capability for investigation and validation.
Fluent, confident communicator able to facilitate senior working sessions and influence decisions.

Languages

Proficient in Business English (written and verbal communication).

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
DST Business Analyst and Business Intelligence Developer - Husky (Guindy,Chennai)

Id:
21074

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

The DST Business Analyst and Business Intelligence Developer for Husky will be responsible for designing, delivering, and maintaining the company’s enterprise business intelligence ecosystem, leveraging both internal and external data sources. This role will lead the development and support of enterprise-wide BI applications, data models, and analytics architecture. Working closely with senior business and IT stakeholders, the position will translate strategic data and information requirements into actionable solutions that enable data-driven decision making.

The incumbent will address complex technical challenges, optimize performance across BI platforms, and define data elements that drive meaningful insights and measurable business value. The role will also establish testing standards, develop and deliver training programs to enhance user adoption, and promote self‑service analytics. Additionally, this position will define governance standards, policies, and procedures for BI tools and data structures, establish data quality metrics, and evaluate emerging technologies to support continuous improvement of Husky’s enterprise BI capabilities.

Key Responsibilities & Key Success Metrics

Leading BI software development, deployment and maintenance
Perform Data Profiling and Data Analysis activities to understand data sources
Report curation, template definition and analytical data modeling
Work with cross-functional teams to gather and document reporting requirements
Translate business requirements into specifications that will be used to implement the required reports and dashboards, created from potentially multiple data sources
Identifies and resolves data reporting issues in a timely fashion, while looking for continuous improvement opportunities.
Build solutions that create value and resolve business problems
Provide technical guidance to designers and other stakeholders
Work effectively with members of Digital Solutions Team
Troubleshoots analytics tool problems and tunes for performance
Develops semantic layer and analytics query objects for end users
Translation of business questions and requirements into reports, views, and analytics query objects
Ensuring that quality standards are met
Supporting Master Data Management Strategy

Qualifications:

Technical Skills & Experience

Strong understanding of ERP and operational system data structures, with the ability to interpret, navigate, and optimize complex relational databases.
Advanced proficiency in writing high‑performance SQL queries against large‑scale, complex datasets, including optimization and troubleshooting.
Hands‑on experience in data visualization, dashboard design, and data storytelling, with the ability to translate analytical insights into clear, compelling, and actionable narratives.
Experience designing, debugging, and deploying BI solutions within an Azure DevOps (ADO) environment, including CI/CD practices, version control, and release management.
Proficiency with the Microsoft BI Stack, including:
Power BI (data modeling, DAX, visualization best practices, Power BI Service)
SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS/AAS)—tabular model development, optimization, and deployment

Experience working with Azure Data Platform services such as Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse Analytics, and Power BI Service.

Knowledge of Databricks or Microsoft Fabric is considered a strong asset.

Business & Functional Knowledge

Basic understanding of manufacturing and sales business processes, with the ability to translate operational requirements into analytical solutions.
Experience working in an international or distributed business environment, collaborating across regions and time zones.

Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills

Strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to interpret requirements, profile data, validate output, and ensure accuracy across BI solutions.
Adept at diagnosing data inconsistencies, performance issues, and modeling challenges, proposing effective, scalable solutions.

Communication & Collaboration

Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of conveying technical concepts to business stakeholders in clear, understandable terms.
Ability to facilitate meetings, workshops, and design sessions, enabling effective collaboration and informed decision-making.
Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams, including Data Engineering, Business Analysts, and business partners.

Language Requirements

Proficiency in English is required.
Knowledge of German or French is considered an asset.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

Maintain new vehicle demand forecast assumptions and support vehicle-sales and vehicle production analysts on related forecast work. Coaching Guides to consistently deliver exceptional student experiences while maintaining Alpha's high standards.
Leading engaging life skills workshops that develop communication, leadership, focus, and other real-world skills for K-12 students.
Motivating students to achieve ambitious learning goals and maximize progress in their self-directed academic programs.
Using data, observation, and coaching conversations to improve Guide performance and student outcomes.
Helping launch and establish new Alpha campuses by building a culture centered on excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What You Won’t Be Doing

Teaching traditional academic classes or delivering subject-matter lectures.
Writing lesson plans or designing curriculum.
Lowering standards to make students feel successful instead of helping them achieve real mastery.
Managing a team from behind a desk without regularly coaching students and Guides firsthand.
Preserving outdated practices simply because "that's how we've always done it."

Education Program Manager Key Responsibilities

Ensure every student consistently experiences Alpha's three promises by building high-performing Guides, delivering engaging life skills experiences, and maintaining uncompromising standards for student success.

Basic Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Education, Psychology, Business, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
At least 5 years of experience in education, coaching, learning and development, or a related leadership role.

new_jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Project Manager - Surveillance & Radar Systems

Shape the Future of Air Traffic Management with Peraton

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA's Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted FAA partner, Peraton delivers the systems and services that keep our nation's skies safe, connected, and operating efficiently.

We're seeking a technically focused Project Manager - Surveillance & Radar Systems
to lead critical initiatives supporting FAA surveillance capabilities and NAS infrastructure. This role is ideal for a strong project leader with experience working with FAA Technical Operations, Airway Transportation Systems Specialists (ATSS), and mission-critical aviation systems
.

Work Location

Position allows for 100% telework (remote)
Preference would be someone local to Herndon, VA so they could attend meetings, but this is not required. What's most important is the FAA experience.

In This Role, You Will

Lead planning and execution of projects supporting surveillance, radar, and related NAS systems.
Manage priorities, resources, schedules, risks, and deliverables to achieve program objectives.
Lead multidisciplinary teams and drive collaboration, accountability, and mission success.
Partner with FAA Technical Operations, ATSS personnel, engineers, system vendors, and program leadership.
Manage stakeholder communication, requirements, action items, and project status.
Identify risks and technical challenges and develop effective mitigation strategies.
Develop project roadmaps, schedules, reports, and other program documentation.
Support modernization, system integration, change management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure work meets FAA, technical, quality, schedule, and mission requirements.

Preferred Technical Experience

The ideal candidate brings experience with FAA Technical Operations (AJW)
and the technical workforce responsible for maintaining the NAS.

Preferred experience includes:

FAA ATSS experience or direct experience supporting ATSS personnel.
Knowledge of surveillance and radar systems, including radar and ADS-B.
Familiarity with FAA communications, navigation, automation, power, and environmental systems.
Understanding of FAA technical training, facility-level certifications, and system-specific qualifications.
Experience working within a mission-critical, highly regulated FAA or aviation environment.

ATSS personnel are the technical specialists responsible for maintaining and sustaining critical NAS systems. Their qualifications are based on FAA technical training, facility certifications, and system-specific proficiency rather than external licenses such as an A&P.

Why This Role Matters

The NAS depends on highly reliable surveillance, radar, communications, navigation, and automation systems. As a Project Manager, you will lead the people and projects responsible for sustaining and modernizing these critical capabilities.

At Peraton, you won't just manage projects-you'll help shape the future of air traffic management.

Qualifications

Position Requirements

U.S. Citizenship required; ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
Bachelor's degree with 8 years of experience, Master's with 6 years, Associate's with 10 years, or HS diploma/equivalent with 12 years of relevant experience.
Project leadership experience supporting surveillance, radar, or related NAS systems.

Experience coordinating installation, modification, system acceptance, and field deployment activities.
